title: Stacked bar chart component
goal: A themed, accessible stacked bar chart for parts per category
acceptance: bx-stacked-bar-chart (or a stacked mode of the bar chart, as T01 decides): several series per bar, legend, totals, segments told apart without colour alone
Unit and browser tests (keyboard, axe in every theme)
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
